name: moneyhub
description: Personal finances with **Supabase as the single source of truth**. A **Claude Project** reads bank-app screenshots and writes facts. A **web app** shows the numbers; its only writes are five owner-checked database functions (manual entries and virtual envelope moves), and reconciliation stays with Claude. Every total, balance and safe-to-spend figure is computed by SQL views, so Claude and the web app always report the same numbers.
